name: dj-except4-homepage
description: DJ Except4 — Modern DJ Homepage with Astro, Tailwind CSS, PWA

scripts.deploy: npm run validate-env && npm run build && chmod -R a+r dist/ && find dist/ -type d -exec chmod a+rx {} \; && rsync -avz --delete dist/ nicolay@staging1:/home/nicolay/dj-except4/dist/ && ssh nicolay@staging1 'docker compose -f /home/nicolay/dj-except4/docker-compose.yml up -d && bash /home/nicolay/dj-except4/verify-deploy.sh'
scripts.deploy:docker: npm run validate-env && npm run build && docker compose up -d --build

author: DJ Except4
